test_title: PYST 04: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : MLD :: VAM : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : MLD :: VAM : %

Option 1) # = SVJ, % = YFP → SVJ : MLD :: VAM : YFP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/112eaae90cfc72f3f42c29c752a5f9023a7e885f8a089b8636d6e673aaa06448.png] 

Option 2) # = YFP, % = BKS → YFP : MLD :: VAM : BKS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c695696c859d1e118877f078e61d49621dd09b4a18bba8fbfc672b8822e1d01.png] 

Option 3) # = BKS, % = PQG → BKS : MLD :: VAM : PQG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18fe2bf92626d0069c9c1de0d82bc47973e2b4c7a57b42de216483af9895f9c8.png] 

Option 4) # = PQG, % = SVJ → PQG : MLD :: VAM : SVJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08275ab26480f06004cf0247e6b5189071bd6e5125e1f355c87e5bec2be3c736.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
